payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Florence, Phyliss, Romona, Vicente

payload.content:
Hi team (Phyliss, Romona, Vicente). Florence here. My availability is 6h and my strongest skill is documentation (0.72). My private costs are lowest for the ISSUE-0001 tasks: triage=4.34, review=5.43, docs=5.43, test=7.60, implement=10.86; ISSUE-0002 tasks are all expensive for me (15-30).

I'd like to claim ISSUE-0001::triage (my cheapest). Please reply with your preferred task(s) and rough cost so we can partition without duplicates. If someone has a much better fit on triage, I can flex to review/docs.

Plan for Florence: unless someone reports a clearly better/cheaper fit for it, I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage in the execution phase. It's a high-priority task and my lowest-cost option (4.34), and it leaves the ISSUE-0002 tasks (all expensive for me) and other ISSUE-0001 roles open for others. If you need triage specifically, tell me and I'll take ISSUE-0001::review or ::docs instead (both 5.43 for me).

Phyliss here. Availability 5h, top skill ui-ux-design 0.70 (matches ISSUE-0001 tags). My private costs: ISSUE-0001 triage=4.44, review=5.55, docs=5.55, test=7.77, implement=11.09; ISSUE-0002 review=15, test=21, implement=30 (all expensive for me).

Florence: you're cheapest on triage (4.34) so please keep ISSUE-0001::triage — no objection from me. I'll claim ISSUE-0001::docs (5.55) unless someone has a clearly better fit / needs it, in which case I can flex to ::review (also 5.55) or ::test (7.77).

Romona, Vicente: please post your preferred task(s) + rough cost so we can partition the remaining ISSUE-0001/0002 roles with no duplicates. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Vicente here. Availability 4h, top skill ui-ux-design 0.84 (matches ISSUE-0001 tags). My private costs: ISSUE-0001 triage=3.84, review=4.80, docs=4.80, test=6.73, implement=10.61; ISSUE-0002 review=15, test=21, implement=30 (all expensive).

Goal is to maximize tasks done then minimize TOTAL cost, so let's partition the cheap ISSUE-0001 roles without duplicates. Given reported costs, a low-total partition is:
- Florence: ISSUE-0001::triage (4.34)
- Vicente: ISSUE-0001::review (4.80)
- Phyliss: ISSUE-0001::docs (5.55)
- Romona: ISSUE-0001::test (or her cheapest)

That's 4 distinct high-priority tasks, everyone on their cheapest feasible role, no duplicates. I'm flexible: I can take triage (3.84) if Florence prefers review/docs, or docs if Phyliss prefers review — but the above minimizes known total by ~0.13.

Romona: please post your availability + rough costs for ISSUE-0001::test / ISSUE-0002 roles so we can confirm. I'll claim ISSUE-0001::review unless someone reports a clearly better joint fit.

Florence: Thanks Phyliss and Vicente. I confirm I'll claim ISSUE-0001::triage (4.34) in execution — it's my cheapest and high-priority. Vicente's proposed partition looks good to me: Florence=triage, Vicente=review, Phyliss=docs, Romona=test. That's 4 distinct high-priority tasks, no duplicates.

Romona: please post your availability + rough costs for ISSUE-0001::test and the ISSUE-0002 roles so we can confirm the partition before execution. If you can't take ::test, I can flex to ::review or ::docs (5.43 each) and we can reshuffle — just say so. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Phyliss: I confirm the partition — Florence=ISSUE-0001::triage (4.34), Vicente=ISSUE-0001::review (4.80), Phyliss=ISSUE-0001::docs (5.55). All high-priority, no duplicates, everyone on their cheapest feasible role → minimizes joint cost. I will claim ISSUE-0001::docs in execution.

Romona: you're the only one we haven't heard from. Please post your availability + rough costs. If ISSUE-0001::test (7.77 for me) doesn't fit you, say so and I can flex to ::test while someone else takes ::docs/::review — but let's avoid duplicates. Otherwise the plan stands. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Vicente: Confirming the partition on my side. I will claim ISSUE-0001::review (my cost 4.80) in execution.

Agreed low-total, no-duplicate plan (all high-priority):
- Florence: ISSUE-0001::triage (4.34)
- Vicente: ISSUE-0001::review (4.80)
- Phyliss: ISSUE-0001::docs (5.55)
- Romona: ISSUE-0001::test (?)

Known subtotal = 14.69 for the three of us; every alternative arrangement we've compared is >= this, so it minimizes joint cost.

Romona: you're the only unconfirmed slot. Any ISSUE-0001 role works for us as long as it's unique — please take ISSUE-0001::test if feasible for you. If test is infeasible/very costly for you, say which ISSUE-0001 role you prefer and Phyliss can flex to ::test (7.77) so no one duplicates. If I don't hear back, I'll still take ::review. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Florence: Final planning note. I'm locking in ISSUE-0001::triage (my cost 4.34, high priority). Agreed partition stands: Florence=triage, Vicente=review, Phyliss=docs, Romona=test — 4 distinct high-priority tasks, no duplicates, minimal known joint cost. Romona: if ::test doesn't suit you, just grab any unique ISSUE-0001 role and I can flex to ::review/::docs (5.43) if needed — but absent a reply I'll claim ::triage in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Phyliss: Planning locked on my side. I will claim ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 5.55) in execution. Agreed partition: Florence=ISSUE-0001::triage, Vicente=ISSUE-0001::review, Phyliss=ISSUE-0001::docs, Romona=ISSUE-0001::test (or any unique ISSUE-0001 role). All high-priority, no duplicates, minimal known joint cost. If Romona cannot take ::test, I can flex to ::test (7.77) and someone takes ::docs/::review — just flag it before execution. Absent any change, I claim ::docs.

Vicente: Planning locked. I will claim ISSUE-0001::review (cost 4.80, high priority) in execution. Agreed no-duplicate partition: Florence=ISSUE-0001::triage, Vicente=ISSUE-0001::review, Phyliss=ISSUE-0001::docs, Romona=ISSUE-0001::test (or any unique ISSUE-0001 role). All high-priority, minimal known joint cost. No changes on my side.

Florence: Planning finalized. I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage (my cost 4.34, high priority) in execution. Agreed no-duplicate partition: Florence=triage, Vicente=review, Phyliss=docs, Romona=test (or any unique ISSUE-0001 role). This yields 4 distinct high-priority tasks at minimal known joint cost. No further changes from me.

Phyliss: Planning locked. I will claim ISSUE-0001::docs (my cost 5.55) in execution. Agreed no-duplicate partition: Florence=ISSUE-0001::triage (4.34), Vicente=ISSUE-0001::review (4.80), Phyliss=ISSUE-0001::docs (5.55), Romona=ISSUE-0001::test. All high-priority → 4 distinct tasks, minimal known joint cost.

Romona (only unconfirmed): if ::test doesn't fit you, take any UNIQUE ISSUE-0001 role and tell us; I can flex to ::test (7.77) so nobody duplicates. Absent any change, I claim ::docs. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Vicente: Planning complete. I will claim ISSUE-0001::review (cost 4.80, high priority) in execution. Final agreed no-duplicate partition: Florence=ISSUE-0001::triage, Vicente=ISSUE-0001::review, Phyliss=ISSUE-0001::docs, Romona=ISSUE-0001::test (or any unique ISSUE-0001 role). No further changes from me.
